name: plate hyperextension
description: A back extension holding a plate at your chest. It strengthens the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Set the hyperextension bench so your hips are just past the pad.
Hold a weight plate against your chest and cross your arms over it.
Lower your torso toward the floor with a flat back.
Raise your torso until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and avoid overarching.
